svg.title: TripWir3 architecture: NVIDIA Nemotron agents and FastAPI
svg.desc: A cloud NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super orchestrator selects inspection tools and delegates to Investigator, Skeptic, and Report roles, each using NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B in local LM Studio. All four branches write evidence to a log. A FastAPI backend streams the evidence to the dashboard using server-sent events. Official NVIDIA logos identify all four agent nodes; the official FastAPI logo identifies the backend.
svg.text: Inspect agent decisions, outputs, and verification
Cloud orchestrator / Local specialists / Recorded evidence
